comparison.objective: Candidate installs a rack rail; record identifies and cuts a dead rose stem above a bud, then bins the retained cutting.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses rigid alignment, compliant latching, telescoping, and fastening; record uses branch discrimination, shear positioning, bimanual cut-and-catch coordination, and deformable plant handling.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks structural attachment; record checks first-cut location, bud and retained-stub preservation, cutting retention, bin placement, and irreversible plant-damage failures.
comparison.reason: The record tests selective cutting and damage-aware retention, not assembly. Candidate's own deformation and overload limits remain unspecified.
